name: simvoro-esim-sms
description: SimVoro: travel eSIM plans, device compatibility and public SMS service prices. Read-only catalog; purchases and code delivery stay on simvoro.com.

interface.shortDescription: Travel eSIM plans and public SMS service prices
interface.longDescription: Connects to the public, read-only SimVoro catalog MCP server (https://simvoro.com/api/mcp). Lists travel eSIM destinations and plans, checks the public device compatibility list, and shows publicly listed SMS services and prices. It never orders, rents numbers or handles verification codes; purchases stay on simvoro.com.
